title: Guides
subtitle: Troubleshooting, migration from ngx-translate, and package version compatibility.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.desc: Common issues when wiring the library into an Angular app.
troubleshooting.empty_title: Empty text or layout jump (FOUC / CLS)
troubleshooting.empty_symptom: Labels render blank, then pop in; or the whole block appears late
troubleshooting.empty_cause: Namespace still loading, wrong loader for SSG, or JSON not served at the expected URL
troubleshooting.empty_fix: Use optional chaining with select() (not @if around the whole UI). Prefer importLoader for prerender/SSG. For httpLoader('/i18n'), put files in public/i18n/{lang}/{ns}.json. Use ready() only for a branded shell if needed.
troubleshooting.missing_symptom: UI shows the key string instead of the translation
troubleshooting.missing_cause: Key missing from JSON, wrong namespace, or typo in path
troubleshooting.missing_fix: Confirm the key exists under the active language. Run ats check --i18n src/i18n --src src. Customize with missingKeyHandler if you want a different fallback.
troubleshooting.lang_symptom: Calling a switch method does nothing or throws
troubleshooting.lang_cause: Using a non-existent API, or language not in supportedLangs
troubleshooting.lang_fix: Use await i18n.setLang('pt-BR') (not use()). Ensure the code is listed in supportedLangs. Configure storageKey to persist the choice.
troubleshooting.pipe_title: Pipe shows nothing or wrong key
troubleshooting.pipe_symptom: Translate pipe empty or prints an unexpected string
troubleshooting.pipe_cause: Missing namespace: separator, or pipe not imported
troubleshooting.pipe_fix: Keys must be namespace:path (e.g. 'common:nav.home'). Import TranslatePipe in the component imports array.
troubleshooting.ssr_symptom: Console hydration errors, or client refetches core namespaces
troubleshooting.ssr_cause: Server and client language differ, or TransferState not applied
troubleshooting.ssr_fix: Keep provideTranslation() on both sides (it owns TransferState). For request-based language, add provideTranslationSSR({ langFromRequest }) on the server. Prefer importLoader for pure SSG.
troubleshooting.cli_symptom: Commands exit with directory not found
troubleshooting.cli_fix: Pass -i src/i18n or --i18n. For HTTP runtime files under public/i18n, either mirror them under src/i18n for tooling or point flags at public/i18n.
troubleshooting.default_lang_title: Validate/clean use the wrong reference language
troubleshooting.default_lang_symptom: Reference is de (or another locale) instead of en
troubleshooting.default_lang_cause: Without --default-lang, the first alphabetically sorted folder wins
troubleshooting.default_lang_fix: Always pass --default-lang en (or your source locale) in scripts and CI.
troubleshooting.instant_symptom: Imperative read is blank even though JSON exists
troubleshooting.instant_cause: Lazy namespace never requested yet; first sync call still returns ''
troubleshooting.instant_fix: Await ensureNamespaces(['settings']) first, or use reactive translate() / select() for UI.
troubleshooting.check_symptom: Keys like og:title or sample snippets fail CI
troubleshooting.check_cause: Any quoted ns:key string is treated as a reference
troubleshooting.check_fix: Point --src at application code (not docs samples), or keep sample keys present in JSON packs.
troubleshooting.ollama_symptom: Connection errors or empty model responses
troubleshooting.ollama_cause: Ollama not running, wrong host/model, or model not pulled
troubleshooting.ollama_fix: Install Ollama, run ollama pull gemma3:12b (or your model), confirm ollama list, and pass --host/--model if not using defaults.

migration.title: Migration from ngx-translate
migration.desc: Map common @ngx-translate/core patterns to this library. Concepts are similar (namespaces ≈ JSON files, keys ≈ dotted paths) but the reactive model is signal-based.
migration.setup_ats: provideTranslation({ defaultLang, supportedLangs, coreNamespaces, loader }) in app config
migration.pipe_ats: {{ 'ns:key' | translate }} — import TranslatePipe; keys need a namespace prefix
migration.lang_ats: i18n.lang() signal; UI updates when signals are used
migration.json_ats: One folder per language, one file per namespace: en/common.json, en/home.json
migration.step1: Install @angular-translation-service/core and add provideTranslation next to (or replacing) ngx-translate providers.
migration.step2: Split monolingual JSON into {lang}/{namespace}.json. Keep nested objects; use ns:path in code.
migration.step3: Replace TranslateService.use with setLang, and get/stream with translate() signals or select().
migration.step4: Update templates to namespace:key pipe form and import TranslatePipe per standalone component.
migration.step5: Remove @ngx-translate/* once screens are migrated. Add ats check / ats validate --default-lang en to CI.
migration.note_params: Interpolation uses {name} in JSON (double braces still accepted).
migration.note_plural: No built-in ICU plurals — use separate keys and conditions, or keep a small helper.
migration.note_events: There is no onLangChange stream; depend on signals inside computed() / templates.

versions.title: Version compatibility
versions.desc: Core and CLI are published independently. Pair recent releases unless a changelog entry requires a specific combo.
versions.core_notes: Angular peer range ^19 – ^22. Signal API: select / translate / instant / setLang.
versions.cli_notes: Binary ats. Type generation augments core; keep CLI ≥ the version that introduced your workflow (scan, mcp, editor).
versions.angular_desc: Peer dependencies accept Angular 19, 20, 21, and 22. The docs app tracks the latest major used in the monorepo toolchain.
versions.pairing_desc: Install the latest core and latest CLI together:
versions.history_034: core 0.3.4 + cli 0.4.6 — dotted-key longest-match resolution aligned across runtime and check/validate
versions.history_note: See CHANGELOG.md in the repository for full release notes and required upgrades.
